propositions: The macOS pytest job (18.6m critical path) spends 15.4m collecting coverage that is not consumed; coverage floor enforcement is redundant across three identical ubuntu cells.
macOS runner concurrency is scarce (capped at 4 concurrent), so jobs waiting for macOS slots are delayed 6.7-8.4m when multiple changes dispatch; reducing macOS job duration frees a shared resource.

Conditional coverage flags per-OS matrix element (ubuntu keeps --cov flags; macOS removes them) eliminates duplicate tracing work while preserving coverage validation on ubuntu and platform-compat test execution on macOS.

GitHub Actions workflow_dispatch resolves reusable workflows from the default branch, not the patchset, so changes to .github/workflows/** cannot be measured in their own Verified run; post-merge observation is required.
